discovery: Prediction and experimental realization of topological insulators and quantized topological edge transport (quantum spin Hall and quantum anomalous Hall effects)

nominees.name: Qikun Xue
nominees.affiliation: Southern University of Science and Technology and Tsinghua University, China

subfield: Condensed matter physics / topological quantum materials
motivation: Kane, with Mele, showed in 2005 that spin-orbit coupling can produce a new time-reversal-invariant topological phase, and later generalized it to three-dimensional topological insulators. Molenkamp's group used precisely engineered HgTe/CdTe quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy to observe the quantum spin Hall effect in 2007, the first experimental topological insulator. Xue's team, through extraordinary control of MBE growth of magnetically doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 thin films, discovered the quantum anomalous Hall effect in 2013: quantized Hall conductance without any external magnetic field. Together these advances established topological band theory as a central organizing principle of condensed matter physics, inspired the search for Majorana modes and topological quantum computation, and point to dissipationless electronics. They show clearly that mastery of crystal growth and heterostructure design opens the way to fundamentally new quantum states of matter.
